title: Madeleine et Georges de Scudéry: Artamène ou le Grand Cyrus
institution: Université de Fribourg (Claude Bourqui, Alexandre Gefen and Barbara Selmeci; original site 2002-2019, Université de Neuchâtel)
author: Madeleine and Georges de Scudéry
notes: Complete text of the novel in diplomatic reproduction (edition of Paris, Courbé, 1656), divided into sequences and episodes with summaries, pop-up notes on characters and places, and the engravings of the 1654 edition. Each of the ten parts can be downloaded as a PDF (https://artamene.othone.org/pdfs/cyrus1.pdf to cyrus10.pdf); the site also gives a full-text search through the ARTFL PhiloLogic server and says TEI files are on the project's GitHub, but no repository could be found. The PDFs were last modified on 6 March 2024. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No licence on the site (home, 'Edition' page, footer), in the TEI header of cyrus1.xml (publicationStmt gives only 'Projet Cyrus', Neuchatel), in the GitHub repository cschuwey/othone (artamene/cyrus*.xml; no LICENSE or README) or in the PDFs (checked 2026-10-13). Note: the TEI files are in github.com/cschuwey/othone/tree/main/artamene, and the new edition was designed by Christophe Schuwey (Universite Bretagne Sud) with Claude Bourqui.
